messages:
laura: Heads up — starting schema change for orders.add_uuid_col in 5m. plan: add nullable col, backfill in chunks, then swap in read path behind flag. canary on shard-7.
alex: I'm on the drain. will quiesce replicas and scale read-only pods down.
dba-sara: FYI prefer online index CONCURRENTLY for new_uuid_idx instead of blocking index. backfill should use limit=200, delay=50ms to avoid seqscans. abort criteria: deadlocks OR any table-level lock > 8s.
deploybot: deploybot: migration run started (id: mj-4987) canary: shard-7 -> executing step add-column (non-blocking).
paul: will pin app to release v2026-05-20 (the runtime that ignores the new column) and flip feature flag only after backfill finishes.
laura: running replica drain now.
```sql
-- verify no blocking locks
select pid, relation::regclass, mode, granted, now() - query_start as active_since from pg_locks l join pg_stat_activity a on l.pid = a.pid where granted = true and relation is not null order by active_since desc limit 10;
```
laura: replicas drained to 3 connections. good to proceed.
deploybot: step apply-index started: create index concurrently new_uuid_idx on orders(new_uuid);
deploybot: ERROR: could not obtain lock on relation "orders". blocked by pid=4123
alex: seeing repeated lock wait spikes from analytic job on replica promoting to primary reads. hmm.
oncall-jim: I'm here. can escalate if we need a forced pause.
dba-sara: decision: hit holdpoint immediately. if we can't get CONCURRENTLY lock within 30s, pause and revert any in-flight partial index.
laura: pausing via deploybot -> `deploybot pause mj-4987`
deploybot: deploybot confirmed: mj-4987 paused at step apply-index (reason: lock-wait-spike).
paul: note: do not run full table lock or immediate index build; we'll avoid any operations that take an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE.
dba-sara: plan: 1) cancel the current index create if still running; 2) kick off backfill with smaller chunks (limit=50) and throttle; 3) schedule index create in next maintenance slot with lighter traffic or use SWITCH TO CREATE AS SELECT approach on a replica.
alex: cancelling active backend 4123 now -> `select pg_cancel_backend(4123);`
laura: cancel returned true, but index create still stuck on lock.
dba-sara: fallback: abort the create on the coordinator and drop any temp state. then re-run backfill replacement path: write uuid into a shadow table and then swap using a CTAS with minimal lock.
paul: adding release note: "orders.add_uuid_col paused due to index lock contention; resumed with shadow-table backfill and scheduled index during maintenance window."
release-bot: release-note added (PR #8240).
laura: updating migration params: `curl -X PATCH https://deploy.internal/migrations/mj-4987 -d '{"backfill_mode":"shadow_table","chunk_limit":50,"throttle_ms":75}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"`
deploybot: parameters accepted; mj-4987 set to shadow_table backfill.
alex: pinned runtime image this run to registry/redwood/runtime:v2026-05-20 to avoid side-effect from recent GC change.
dba-sara: I'll monitor for deadlocks and watch replication lag while the shadow backfill runs. if replication lag > 30s, we pause.
oncall-jim: health checks green currently. I'll keep eyes on replication lag and alert oncall if it rises.
laura: resuming mj-4987 (shadow backfill) -> deploybot resumed.
deploybot: mj-4987 resumed. monitoring progress. next holdpoint: if any table-level lock > 8s, auto-pause.
alex: immediate checks: no locks >5s. shadow backfill chunk 1/120 processed.
dba-sara: good. keeping the index build scheduled for the low-traffic slot at 03:00 UTC with ops present to run it manually.
paul: final note: feature flag will remain off until index built and smoke-tests pass. will merge migration changelog into release notes after completion.
laura: thanks everyone — will post final status to #ops when done. :white_check_mark:
